post.title: You only get about 4,000 weeks. ⏳
post.description:
Send this to someone who keeps saying 'someday'.

If you live to 80, that is roughly 4,170 weeks in total.
post.pinned_comment: How will you spend this week? 👇

scenes.narration: If you live to eighty, you get about four thousand weeks. That's it. Four thousand.
It sounds like a lot, until you realize you have already spent a big part of them.
At twenty, about a quarter is gone. At forty, half.
Most people spend their weeks waiting. Waiting for Friday. Waiting for summer. Waiting for someday.
But someday is not on the calendar. It never was.
Every week you spend doing something you hate, out of fear, is a week you will never get back.
Every week you spend scrolling through other people's lives is one less week of your own.
This is not meant to scare you. It's meant to wake you up.
Time is the only thing you can never earn back. Not with money. Not with luck.
So spend your weeks like they are rare. Because they are.
Call the person. Start the project. Take the trip. This week, not someday.
So tell me. How will you spend this week?
